description: Standard camera movement for shots. An AI+ shot plays one gentle push-in and has no move to choose, so it is skipped; if every named shot is AI+ the tool refuses. It does not remove AI+ from a shot.

movement.description: The camera move: push-in, pull-out, orbit-right or orbit-left.

photoIds.description: The shots: each a photoId from the edit summary, or a play position like 'shot 3'.

items.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".

name: set_movement
title: Camera movement
